messages:
Olivia Chen: Heads-up team 1 0: we need a tight social plan for the ModelServe v1.2 rollout. Objectives: webinar signups, demo requests, and benchmark downloads. Primary publish: Tue 10:00 PT. Deliverables: 6-tweet thread, 2 LinkedIn posts (company + founder), 3 single-image X posts, assets for stories.

Jamal Reed: Confirming the tracking scheme before we post. Use utm_campaign=msv1_2_launch, utm_source=social, utm_content to indicate slot (e.g., x_thread_t1, company_post). LinkedIn leads -> MKT_LAUNCH_LINKEDIN; X demo asks -> MKT_SOCIAL_INBOUND. I'll wire SFDC mapping.

Sara Patel: Design ETA: 3 hero images + story vertical + 3 small thread cards by EOD tomorrow. Need final short/long overlay copy (<=55 chars / <=140 chars) and alt text.

Alex Gomez: Draft thread below. I'll own scheduling. Feedback welcome.

Alex Gomez: "Tweet 1: ModelServe v1.2 is live 6a1 Faster kernels, smarter routing, and lower inference costs. Join our launch webinar: [short link]
Tweet 2: Why it matters: production apps require predictable latency + cost. v1.2 adds smarter batching and KV caching to reduce tail latency.
Tweet 3: Highlights: up to 3x throughput (workload dependent) on long-context jobs; 15-30% token-cost savings with intelligent quantization.
Tweet 4: Ops features: canary rollouts, per-route SLOs, and automatic fallback to cheaper model variants.
Tweet 5: We9ll publish benchmark slides and an open test-config repo during the webinar. Bring your workload questions.
Tweet 6: Register for live Q&A (APAC session available): [webinar link] #ModelServe #LLMinfra #RedwoodInference"

Olivia Chen: Legal asked to qualify the performance numbers with "workload dependent"  and to mention APAC session in at least two posts. Also request founder POV draft.

Alex Gomez: Added qualifiers and APAC note. Draft LinkedIn posts below.

Alex Gomez: "Company LinkedIn: Today we9re launching ModelServe v1.2 0 designed for predictable inference at scale. Teams can see up to 3x throughput (workload dependent) on long-context workloads and 15-30% lower token costs with smarter batching and quantization. Join our webinar for benchmarks and a live demo: [link]"

Alex Gomez: "Founder LinkedIn: We built ModelServe because production reliability matters. Too many teams sacrifice latency or cost when scaling LLMs. With v1.2 we focused on smarter routing and graceful fallbacks so apps stay online without oversized hardware. If you run LLMs in prod, join our webinar to see the trade-offs and benchmarks: [link]"

Sara Patel: Short overlay suggestion: "Predictable inference at scale" (34 chars). Long overlay suggestion: "ModelServe v1.2: smarter routing, faster kernels, lower token cost" (67 chars). I'll produce light/dark variants and include alt text.

Ethan Park: Paid boost rec: company LinkedIn post for 48 hours targeting infra/product managers and platform engineers. Small budget to maximize demo signups. I'll set audiences and conversion tracking.

Maria Liu: Lead routing checklist: landing form -> SFDC web-to-lead with campaign mapping. Default owner -> MKT_QUAL. SalesOps to create "webinar - followup" task with 24hr SLA. Social DM demo requests -> create Zendesk ticket tag=social-demo and notify #sales-inbound. APAC leads -> apac-sdr-group. Use utm_content tags for per-post campaign attribution.

Olivia Chen: Need 3 short reply templates for social ops. Drafts below.

Alex Gomez: Reply templates:
- Demo ask: "Thanks! We'd love to demo ModelServe 1.2  can I DM a short link to pick a 15-min slot?"
- Webinar signup: "Thanks for registering! Calendar invite coming. Anything specific you'd like us to cover?"
- Benchmark ask: "We'll share benchmark slides in the webinar. Want early access? Drop your email and we'll send the deck."

Sara Patel: CTA buttons: "Register" and "Request demo" variants included on hero images. Uploading to Figma: /ModelServe/LaunchAssets.

DesignBot: Files uploaded: https://figma.com/file/example/modelserve-launch-assets (mock link). Alt text provided.

Jamal Reed: Landing page and short link ready: https://rwd.in/msv1-2 (placeholder). Legal review requested for the performance claims.

Alex Gomez: I'll queue posts in the scheduling tool and tag them "launch_priority". Holding publish until Olivia gives final approval and landing link confirmed.

Olivia Chen: Owners recap: Alex = scheduling & copy, Sara = design, Maria = lead routing & links, Jamal = landing page & legal, Ethan = paid boost, Olivia = final approvals. Mark done in-thread when complete. Publish after legal sign-off and final link. Thanks all! :rocket:
